hookContract.metadataReader: Reuse scripts/toolchains/read-default-catalog.cjs for published version authority. Native updateConfig supplies its parsed canonical patchedDependencies settings; do not add another YAML parser or depend on installed yaml during bootstrap.
hookContract.nativeSourceFinding: NodeJsHooks.update_config and read_package both call the same lazy self.worker(); the worker loads the module once and retains it for multiple requests. Config-dependency preparation returns the loaded hook objects that ran updateConfig. This supports initialize(config) then readPackage(pkg) without a duplicate metadata flag.
hookContract.failClosed: Uninitialized workers, ambiguous/changed Nextra selectors, changed published catalog versions, changed original dependency range, missing or altered complete patch/provenance and incomplete generated inventories fail. Unregistered patch files do not remove the edge. Already-retired physical metadata must match the exact generated dependency map.

If a separate worker bypasses initialization, stop; do not fall back to file presence or a new YAML reader.
